CustomField.description: Stores a custom WHERE clause used to select related records dynamically when creating action plans from this template.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A custom WHERE clause that can be used to select specific records when creating action plans from this template. Do not include the keyword WHERE. Note: When a WHERE Clause is specified, action plans will be created for each matching record at runtime, rather than for specific records.
CustomField.label: WHERE Clause
